title: Contact — LucrumTech
description: Tell us what you're building. Thirty minutes — we'll ask what you're solving, who it's for, and what's blocking it, and tell you honestly how we'd approach it.
lede: Thirty minutes. We'll ask what you're solving, who it's for, and what's blocking it — and tell you honestly how we'd approach it. No deck.

urgent.h1: Tell us what is going wrong.
urgent.lede: The more specific you are, the faster we can tell you whether we can help — and whether you even need us. We can start within 72 hours.
